title: Settings
languageHelp: This choice stays on this device. Other people in the family can use a different one.
mobileBody: Install Preppr as an app on your phone for quicker access and a better offline shopping list.
mobileLink: How to install the app (Android and iPhone)
modelBody: Choose the AI used to generate your menus. The API key is stored with your family data on the server.
geminiStep1: Open Google AI Studio, “Get API key” menu:
geminiStep2: Create or copy the API key.
claudeStep2: Create an account and add credits.
claudeStep3: Generate an API key and paste it below.
aislesBody: Display order of aisles on the shopping list (the path through your store). Synced with your family, like recipes and the shopping list.
contextBody: These fields are the user context sent to the menu generator. They are synced for the whole family (same account).
interactionHint: (tone, reply length, how you like to exchange)
resetAllTitle: Clears the API key and restores the default user context
exportBody: Downloads the exact system instructions sent to the model (user context + JSON rules), as when you send a message in the menu generator.

account.title: My account
account.offline: A connection is required to manage the account.
account.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices signed in to this account will need to sign in again.
account.householdsBody: Each account has its own recipes and its own shopping list. People in the same household share one account. You can rename a household or delete it: deletion removes its recipes and its list. Pass on the username and password yourself.
account.resetWarning: Devices signed in to “{{login}}” will be signed out. With this password you could also sign in to that household: only use it to help someone who forgot theirs.
account.renameWarning: Recipes and the shopping list are kept. Devices signed in to this household will need to sign in again with the new username.
account.deleteWarning: Recipes, the shopping list and the settings of “{{login}}” will be erased. This cannot be undone. Devices signed in to this household will be signed out.
account.deleteMismatch: The username you typed does not match.
